title: GTA 6 aaj se India mein launch: ₹5,999 mein kya naya?
hooks: Launch hua GTA 6 India mein aaj raat 12 baje
Abhi khelo, GTA 6 India mein live hai
hook_why: First word 'Launch' is a high-stakes verb, matches top Shorts' 'Urgent Interruption' hook style, and the 12 AM IST timing creates immediate urgency for Indian viewers.
metaphor: Canopy Peel: a horizontal plane descends through a PS5/Xbox console, peeling layers to reveal GTA 6 case, then Lucia/Jason artwork, then Vice City map — each layer on the beat with a histogram tracking depth.

caption:
GTA 6 finally dropped in India at ₹5,999! 🎮 13 saal ka intezaar khatam. Lucia-Jason ki Vice City kaisi lagi?

PS5 ya Xbox — kaunsa console pe khel rahe ho? Comment mein batao! 👇

fresh_fixed: scene 1: 'Launch hua GTA 6 India mein aaj raat 12 baje, abhi download shuru karo' implies it is about to launch or just launched, but the script also says 'abhi download shuru karo' (start downloading now) when the game is already live/playable as of 12:00 AM IST on Nov 19, 2026. The script is mostly accurate, but 'abhi download shuru karo' is slightly misleading as the game is already available for play.
